Title: Separation and Reliability by Facet
SavedHoldMessage: Rating cohorts are disconnected across unanchored facets; cross-cohort MML scale alignment relies solely on the assumed common person distribution rather than shared observations or anchors.
Note: Four descriptive precision series per facet: SEMode = model (ModelSE) vs fit_adjusted (RealSE = ModelSE * sqrt(max(Infit, 1))) crossed with DistributionBasis = sample (ddof=1) vs population (ddof=0). All derived separation/reliability indices are exploratory summaries (Use = screening_only; SupportsFormalInference = FALSE) and do not propagate inter-estimate covariance. EstimateAvailable, SEAvailable, ExcludedLevels and AggregationTarget state the exact calculation scope; JMLE extreme-score boundary persons without finite estimates are excluded explicitly rather than silently dropped. Precision cells (RMSE, TrueSD, Separation, Strata, Reliability) are blank where Use = withheld; inspect StatusReason for the exact cause. Strata (H) = (4G+1)/3 is a conceptual index of distinguishable levels, derived from separation G, not an observed group count or a grouping rule. H = 3 does not establish three actual groups or their cut scores. Reliability here concerns differentiation, not inter-rater agreement; low rater separation can also reflect imprecision. For MML EAP person estimates, Separation = SD(EAP) / RMSE and Reliability = Var(EAP) / (Var(EAP) + RMSE^2); conditional posterior SD is not the sampling SE of EAP. Full notes and original technical values are retained in this project.
